title: The XL Instances and the CVRPLib Best Known Solution Challenge
summary: This paper introduces the XL set, a new collection of large-scale benchmark instances for the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP). The set extends previous benchmarks by covering instances with 1,000 to 10,000 customers and a wide range of structural characteristics, following established generation principles from prior CVRP studies. To provide strong reference solutions, we conducted an extensive computational study with several state-of-the-art algorithms and retained the best solutions obtained as the starting point for a community-driven BKS challenge hosted on the CVRPLib…
